sn51.19:1.1: Iddhiṃ vo bhikkhave desissāmi iddhipādaṃ ca iddhipādabhāvanaṃ ca iddhipādabhāvanāgāminiṃ ca paṭipadaṃ ||
sn51.19:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu anekavihitam iddhividham paccanubhoti || eko pi hutvā bahudhā hoti || pe-la || yāva brahmalokā pi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti || ||
sn51.19:3.2: Yo bhikkhave maggo yā paṭipadā iddhilābhāya iddhipaṭilābhāya saṃvattati ||
sn51.19:4.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgatam iddhipādam bhāveti ||
sn51.19:5.2: ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo || seyyathīdam
sn51.19:5.4: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave iddhipādabhāvanāgāminī paṭipadā ti || || I. 2.
